# Feature Specification: The spec-to-code chain mirrored in Utopia

Every spec, ADR and other markdown document lore-api ingests is also written into Utopia, the knowledge-graph service deployed beside Lore, as the chain it draws from the document: the document, its sections, their statements, and the tests, source files and ADRs each statement links. ADR-052 records why.

## Background

Dgraph holds the traceability graph today and is to be retired. Utopia already runs in the cluster and keeps a typed graph, but it cannot yet answer two of the reads Lore's checks make, so the chain is mirrored there beside Dgraph rather than moved. The mirror is a copy: nothing in Lore reads it yet, and its failure never fails an ingest.

Assembly run ingest on re-cinq/lore failed.
Branch: ingest/specs/385e586d93a971dbbe46cc048d2bc5692546ac41
Reason: node "ingest" failed

## Slices

1. **Code-to-spec relations mirrored on ingest** (this slice): on every spec/ADR ingest lore-api pushes the chain into the repo's Utopia KB; Lore ontology shipped and imported per repo; per-repo settings `utopia: {kb_id, source_id, source_key}` written by a one-time setup route; NetworkPolicy + registration closed (#2765); ADR-052 + spec.
2. Upstream deeplethe/utopia: deterministic typing (phrase == declared relation key binds without a model; materialize after a push); a write-scoped token may create a KB and a source so Lore can create the project itself.
3. Code call graph (`defines`, `references`, `imports`), then tests with coverage ranges.
4. Decide where Lore's own checks read from once Utopia returns qualifiers and can answer "no X"; move readers; delete Dgraph.

## Context

Lore must push specs, ADRs and docs to Utopia after graph projection.

## What to change

Add calls to mirror logic in delta route when UTOPIA_API_URL is set.

Target file: `apps/lore-api/src/transport/routes/ingest/ingest-delta.ts`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Ingests trigger mirror logic without failing the ingest on error.

## How to test

Run ingest-delta.test.ts to verify mirror calls and error swallowing.

- [specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md#the-ingest](https://github.com/re-cinq/lore/blob/HEAD/specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md#the-ingest)
